language.name: English
settings.Language.description: Change the inventory terminal and its settings labels without changing the game's language.
settings.ToggleKey.description: Open or close the inventory terminal (default F7). This key is listed in the game's Input/Controls settings.
settings.ContainerPlacement.description: Choose the default destination for a drop on the terminal.
settings.KeepDraggingAfterUse.descriptio: Keep the item ready after one click on Use or Drain. Each click triggers once; turn it off to finish the drag.
terminal.title: Terminal
inventory.scroll.description: Drag the scrollbar or use the mouse wheel.
inventory.drag.drain.description: Drop a container here, then click left mouse once to drain.
inventory.drag.use.description: Drop the item here, then left-click to use it.
inventory.drag.pin.description: Drop the item here to pin it at the top of the terminal.
inventory.drag.unpin.description: Drop a locked item here to remove it from the pinned row.
